## Description

Proposed model for liquidity-shock detection and response: Estimate when spreads, depth, or order-flow intensity may deteriorate and adapt trade size, timing, or order placement to reduce execution risk. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
